title: PAH-OMC-020 full objective requirement audit and branch split
question: Do the current hash-pinned authorities satisfy every requirement of the original PAH-OMC-020 j-before-n stationary-correlation objective, and which obligations remain after separating the immutable-source negative from an owner-fixed successor?
method: Freeze PAH-001 and the registered R-537, R-555, R-557 and R-559 authorities by their current SHA-256 values.

Map the objective into source semigroup identity, fixed-n j-to-infinity control, anchored-n target identification, compact-time uniform correlation transfer and independent/hostile/Lean verification roles.
Read each requirement against its authoritative result scope rather than treating conditional algebra or source absence as convergence evidence.
Report the immutable-source branch and any separately owner-fixed successor branch without changing the original function, rates, state, time or order.
finding: The requirement audit has a split outcome. The immutable PAH-001 branch is covered by R-559's scoped NEGATIVE_RESULT: current bytes do not select one finite stationary semigroup. The fixed-n J bridge (R-537/R-555), anchored-n D and R-512 minimal-form identification (R-536/R-538/R-557), and full compact-time local-correlation transfer remain conditional or missing for any owner-fixed successor. Existing primary, independent, hostile and Lean evidence verifies the conditional contracts, not the final ordered convergence theorem.
decision_reason: This audit does not redefine the goal or promote a smaller theorem. It makes the completion boundary explicit: the original source formulation has a scoped negative, while the requested R-512 ordered convergence remains unproved until a single owner-authorized successor packet instantiates every missing dynamic and form field.
boundary: PAH-001 functional, original transition rates, labelled Gibbs state, external stochastic Markov time, carrier, normalization and j-before-anchored-n order remain unchanged. No new comparison map, carrier, counterterm, direct sum, averaging or physical interpretation is introduced.

source_finite_stationary_semigroup.meaning: Immutable PAH-001 does not select one unique finite semigroup; this is not a universal successor no-go.

fixed_n_j_to_infinity.missing: Source-authorized full-domain J_(n,j) estimate for every declared local cylinder pair and compact time interval.

anchored_n_D_and_R512.missing: Common realization, arbitrary-sequence liminf/recovery, boundary escape, minimal-form identification and anchored D_n control.

compact_time_local_correlation_transfer.missing: Source-authorized common core, initial recovery and integrable residual bridge.

verification_roles.meaning: Primary, independent, hostile and Lean checks do not substitute for the missing source-owned packet.

verification_summary: This is a requirement-to-authority audit. It reuses already verified result packages and adds no finite numerical fixture. The source-delta check remains PASS_NO_NEW_INPUT; no new owner packet is present.
next_action: Keep the full PAH-OMC-020 goal active but parked at the exact owner-packet cut-set. Reopen only when one source-authorized packet supplies the missing J/D/common-core/N2 fields or a genuine parent-byte change appears; then run the unchanged admission verifier and all four verification roles.
revisit_condition: Reopen on a new source-authorized hash-pinned packet, a genuine PAH parent-byte change, or an exact PAH-specific contradiction to one requirement. Do not repeat finite or abstract audits without such an input.
non_claims: This audit does not prove the R-512 minimal-form semigroup convergence or any owner-fixed successor theorem.
The scoped source-level negative is not a universal no-go for every successor completion.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion is made.
